title: Malaysia & Singapore, from the Malay and Chinese press

stories.text: Perikatan Nasional will challenge the Registrar of Societies' decision in court, Takiyuddin said.
Muhyiddin called the cancellation of PN's registration a reminder to act fairly toward all of the coalition's member parties.
Sanusi said PN can use the PAS logo in the Melaka state election.
Rafizi claimed Anwar misled the Dewan Rakyat over the 'corporate mafia' issue.
Interpol issued a Red Notice against the founder of Serba Dinamik.
AirAsia group shares fell to a four-year low after the government did not agree to provide financial aid.
stories.source: Sin Chew Daily 星洲日报

stories.text: Net pay for the M40 middle-income group is expected to rise from January next year.
Palm oil prices rose on an expected export tax exemption.
stories.source: Sin Chew Daily 星洲日报

stories.text: The issue of the dismissal of 10 Negeri Sembilan state executive councillors will be answered during the winding-up session.
Schools in six states, Kuala Lumpur and Putrajaya will operate on Wednesday (Oct 21).
Singapore's Prime Minister arrived in the UAE, continuing his official visit to the Middle East.
Singapore's media regulator IMDA fined Singtel $1 million over a March mobile outage that affected 720,000 people.
Singapore's CPF system kept its A grade for a second year.
A survey found most Singapore households expect inflation to rise in 2027.
Singapore's Manpower Ministry issued extra haze guidance urging employers to adjust outdoor work based on PM2.5 levels.
